newsitem.title: JAPAN: Landesbank says to launch $500 mln 5-yr issues.
newsitem.headline: Landesbank says to launch $500 mln 5-yr issues.

text.p: Germany"s Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz AG is planning to launch $500 million worth of five-year benchmark issues targetted at the European and Asian markets for institutional investors this week, a senior official at the bank said on Monday.

Paul Schminke, a member of the board of managing directors at Landesbank, told reporters that the issue will be jointly managed by the Industrial Bank of Japan and Merrill Lynch this week, possibly on Wednesday, depending on market conditions on Tuesday.
Schminke said that the bank will continue offering yen-based bond issues for Japanese retail investors in 1997.

"In the last couple of months we have made three (yen-based) retail targetted issues (for Japanese investors). They were very successfully placed issues...and we"ll continue to offer such issues this year," he said.
Schminke said that it may offer samurai bonds in the future, but recent market conditions would make it difficult.
